sloka: अहम् तावन् महा राजे पितृत्वम् न उपलक्षये ।भ्राता भर्ता च बन्धुः च पिता च मम राघवः ॥२-५८-३१॥
transliteration: aham tāvan mahā rāje pitṛtvam na upalakṣaye ।bhrātā bhartā ca bandhuḥ ca pitā ca mama rāghavaḥ ॥2-58-31॥

translations.english: 'I do not regard the great king as my father. Rama alone is my brother, protector, friend and father.
